title: Synthetic multi-port scan
objective: Confirm that a concentrated burst of connection attempts is detected, grouped, and converted into a simulated containment recommendation.
authorization_boundary: Synthetic telemetry only. No packets are generated and no network device is contacted.
expected_outcome: One high-severity detection backed by at least five events and five distinct destination ports within sixty seconds.

rules.name: Multi-port connection burst
rules.description: A single source touches several destination ports in a short window.

response.description: Recommend isolating the synthetic source segment and preserving the matched event set for analyst review.
